title: The camera writes the collection
governingQuestion: Who establishes the canonical view, and under what rights?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: London makes the week visible as a relay among institutional schedule, temporary room, camera, platform, labor, commerce and archive. This chapter follows capture: The collection walks once; cameras, edits, metadata and rights agreements decide which view can be repeated and who can repeat it.
beats.onScreen: Then: Runway photography and broadcast do more than document a collection: their framing helps establish the version that circulates and survives.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: Runway photography and broadcast do more than document a collection: their framing helps establish the version that circulates and survives. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The official London Fashion Week platform combines event pages with designer-controlled films and BFC video channels, making moving image part of the event’s attributable public record rather than an after-the-fact add-on.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The bounded search in G-FUTURE-07 did not establish a documented BFC deployment of generative image production; search and classification are not mislabeled as generation.
